0x000867.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008D8.en: 「Ngh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000960.en: 「Dammit! @　Next time you won't get me!」

0x000A51.en: 「Time to call it...! I'm pulling out.」

0x000A89.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000B8A.en: 「Hngh! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000BC5.en: 「Like hell I'll blow it here...!@　This ain't fun...」

0x000C19.en: 「Blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000C8D.en: 「Gah! Nothing to do but fall back!!」

0x000D03.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D6A.en: 「This is it... the rest is on you.」

0x000E16.en: 「No good, I've taken too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000E63.en: 「Well, I'm beat. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EA1.en: 「Kyah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000EE8.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F93.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x0010CF.en: 「Ngh...! So this is where it ends...!」

0x00113C.en: 「Tch! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001183.en: 「I'm sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x0011B8.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...?!」

0x0011FC.en: 「I can't fight any longer! Pulling back!」

0x0012A4.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still not good enough...!」

0x0012F2.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001336.en: 「Is this... where it ends for me...?!」

0x00136B.en: 「Sorry!@ I'm gonna sit this one out...!」

0x0013DC.en: 「Ah, no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00141A.en: 「Well, well... so this is where it ends.」

0x001449.en: 「I can go no further. I'll take my leave.」

0x0014D4.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x00163A.en: 「Ejecting...@ Ngh...! Not very graceful of me...」

0x0016F8.en: 「Guuh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x00193C.en: 「I have no choice but to fall back...!」

0x0019A5.en: 「The confirmed blast locations match up almost exactly@ with the lunar cities and Federation bases.@ The Guests are behind this.」

0x001A3B.en: 「They saw Earth's blockade as their chance and made their move.@ What's the current situation?」

0x001A9A.en: 「The fighting is still ongoing.@ The blasts have grown more sporadic, but...」

0x001B02.en: 「If the Guests' aim is the same as the <Inspectors'>,@ they'll try to seize the bases as intact as possible...」

0x001B8A.en: 「The Federation forces aren't facing them for the first time either.@ The battle's probably a back-and-forth.」

0x001C01.en: 「But if Roff's group wasn't the enemy's original force,@ and these are reinforcements from home...@ sheer numbers could overwhelm them.」

0x001CAC.en: 「...What'll it be, Captain?@ Do we press on toward Heaven's Gate,@ or head for the moon?」

0x001D3E.en: 「Contact on radar!@ Multiple high-heat sources closing in!@ Bearing zero, dead ahead, 15 degrees elevation!」

0x001E12.en: 「If they've come from the direction of Heaven's Gate...」

0x001E5E.en: 「Either way, we intercept the enemy!@ All hands, battle stations one! Major Kai, launch!」

0x001EEB.en: 「The ship holds this position.@ All units, destroy the Ruina ahead@ and secure our course!」

0x001F6C.en: (This presence lingering over the battlefield... what is it...?@ Is someone watching us...?)

0x001FCB.en: 「Elebe 1 to all units.@ We can't afford to get bogged down here.@ We'll blast a hole open, fast!」

0x002068.en: 「All units, keep a sharp watch all around.」

0x002096.en: 「...Those enemies came from the direction of Heaven's Gate.@ Could it be that place is already...?」

0x00215D.en: 「...I still feel like something's out there on this battlefield...」

0x0021A6.en: 「Huh? But the sensors aren't picking up anything...」

0x00222F.en: 「It's not exactly that, but...@ my senses feel different from when we were on the ground...」

0x002294.en: 「They say your five senses get sharper once you're out in space.」

0x0022E0.en: 「That so?@ Doesn't feel any different to me, though.」

0x002361.en: 「Actually, for me too... not much changes.」

0x0023B4.en: 「If your senses don't change between ground and space,@ then that's impressive in its own right.@ In terms of spatial awareness, I mean.」

0x002447.en: 「Contact, radar! Multiple heat sources incoming!@ Bearing 10 o'clock, 20 degrees down, dead ahead!@ Entering range 3 shortly!」

0x002530.en: 「Identify them, quickly!@ All gun turrets, all units, prepare to intercept!」

0x0025AF.en: 「Hmph. A traitor and a deserter, in a place like this.」

0x002633.en: 「So the Beta Saber came up@ into space...!」

0x002683.en: 「Indeed, to support the Antarctic operation from above.@ And you? What are you doing in space?」

0x002709.en: 「We were on our way, heading for Heaven's Gate.」

0x002755.en: 「You, the ones who killed the President?@ You're in the wrong place entirely.」

0x0027B7.en: 「That's a false charge!@ Launching the President's craft at that exact moment@ was itself...」

0x002841.en: 「Babble all you want,@ it won't change the fact that the President is dead.」

0x0028A4.en: 「The President died because of us... that fact...」

0x0028E4.en: 「Disarm at once and surrender.@ If you refuse, we open fire.」

0x002946.en: 「Is that your top priority?@ Earth has vanished, an emergency beyond reckoning,@ and it means nothing to you?」

0x0029CD.en: 「Of course I recognize it as a grave problem.」

0x002A1D.en: 「We, the Gaia Sabers, will wipe out the outside threat.@ If you truly fear this crisis,@ then surrender, and be quick about it.」

0x002AB9.en: 「I must hurry to Heaven's Gate...@ There's no time to waste.」

0x002B15.en: 「Then why not just go, and leave us be?」

0x002B55.en: 「Silence, Ariel.@ I'm giving you one last chance.」

0x002BD3.en: 「Surrender now, and I'll press for your charges@ to be reduced.」

0x002C3E.en: 「That's the consideration I can offer you,@ as one of the last two... fellow Idealants.」

0x002CB6.en: 「But, Ing... I can guarantee nothing for you.」

0x002CF9.en: 「...My feelings won't change.@ I won't obey you.」

0x002D46.en: 「Hmph... then let's hear the commander's view.」

0x002D83.en: 「I admit our ship collided with the President's craft@ and destroyed it... but the events leading up to it@ are riddled with doubt.」

0x002E2B.en: 「Before that, the GS's current privileges don't@ authorize you to give orders to the Federation forces.」

0x002E96.en: 「So we said we'd go through the proper channels,@ answer for it in the proper place,@ and asked to explain directly to the President.」

0x002F47.en: 「Yet even though the President was present,@ Alteur Steinbeck@ refused it.」

0x002FDA.en: 「And the Gaia Sabers struck first,@ launching the President's craft mid-combat.@ In that situation, a dangerous, unnatural move.」

0x0030A0.en: 「Are you suggesting there's something behind it?」

0x0030D7.en: 「Yes. Wasn't Alteur's true aim to assassinate the President...@ and pin the crime on us?」

0x003182.en: (Hmph... that man's capable of exactly that.)

0x0031BC.en: 「The Gaia Sabers' fleet formation at that time@ could well have been arranged to deliberately@ drive us off in one specific direction.」

0x003258.en: 「And conveniently, the Urchins appeared right in our path...@ Why did the Guests send in only their@ armed-reconnaissance units?」

0x0032FA.en: 「Their reasons are no concern of mine.」

0x003328.en: 「The Urchins appeared around the time of the DC War.@ They could have been captured and put to use.」

0x003396.en: 「Quite the vivid imagination.@ You can spin a story like that any way you please.」

0x0033F5.en: 「Then one could just as well say people believe@ the story the Gaia Sabers built and announced.」

0x00346F.en: 「Enough. As I said before,@ the fact that you did away with the President@ will not be overturned.」

0x0034ED.en: 「Even if we bear the rebels' disgrace for now,@ we'll reveal the truth in the proper place,@ then accept judgment for our crimes.」

0x0035AA.en: 「...In other words, you refuse the call to surrender?」

0x003628.en: 「Yes.@ The Gaia Sabers are a dangerous presence.@ The President's death only confirmed it for me.」

0x0036A9.en: 「But you can't cast off being an Idealant.@ And unless you and I stand together,@ Project Idealants can't be completed.」

0x00376C.en: 「But the two of us alone can't--!」

0x003791.en: 「It's Fau Kern...@ If we can draw out its full power,@ our true purpose will be fulfilled!」

0x003812.en: 「Yours, you mean!@ That way of thinking is what's dangerous, Duvan!」

0x00386E.en: 「I'm forcing it through!@ All units, commence attack! Crush them!」

0x0038BE.en: 「Captain, we intercept the moment they move. No objection?」

0x003907.en: 「We have no choice.@ But to avoid losses here,@ the ship will attempt to break away from this battle zone.」

0x003991.en: 「Understood.@ Once the escape course is set, we'll secure our path.@ All units, don't stray too far from the Hagane.」

0x003A18.en: 「Once Fau Kern shows its true worth,@ I'll be able to obtain everything!」

0x003AC6.en: 「No, you should know it too!@ Someone has already seized the power of the <Einst>@ and succeeded in controlling it!」

0x003BF5.en: 「High-heat source, closing in!@ Bearing 3 o'clock, 30 degrees elevation, dead ahead! Just one!」

0x003C57.en: 「Just one...? Could it be Melior Esse?!」

0x003C9D.en: 「No, we've got a match!@　It's the Red Ogre!」

0x003D03.en: 「That nostalgic feeling, and that uneasy one...@　So this is the source.」

0x003E77.en: 「Well, we remember you just fine,@　you cute little Einst.」

0x003ED3.en: 「You know that I'm an Einst...@　Which means you're...」

0x003F2F.en: 「Don't tell me she's lost her memory?」

0x003F63.en: 「Huh? When did you cross over to 'this side'...?」

0x003FA9.en: 「'This side'? What are you on about?」

0x00401E.en: 「...It's all come rushing back to me now.@　It's been a while, everyone.」

0x004086.en: 「Talk about sudden.@　Were you really amnesiac?」

0x0040CD.en: 「I heard about it from Ratsel and Shouko.@　You were with Kouta and Axel Almer,@　weren't you?」

0x00418B.en: 「Where have you been all this time?@　What happened to those two?」

0x004227.en: 「The output limit and limiter settings are...!@ Code U.U.N, available for use...?@ A new attack pattern from the Flickerei...?」

0x004318.en: （Is that what I was sensing...?@　But why...?）

0x004371.en: 「No doubt about it, the Fau Kern is activating!」

0x0043BA.en: 「That's a Jetzt... from a Regiseia...?@　There were still some left...?」

0x004425.en: 「The Red Ogre... a true Einst!@　Just approaching it gives us these numbers...@　If I get that, Ares' Fau Kern will...!」

0x0044D9.en: 「What I am now is an Einst...@　and yet not an Einst...」

0x00453E.en: 「You're not making any sense...@　What is that Red Ogre, then!?」

0x0045A3.en: 「That's a bit of a problem too...@　I spent power making it manifest...」

0x004614.en: 「Then that works out well for us.」

0x004648.en: 「That core is a bootleg knockoff, non-refundable...@　So then...」

0x0046AA.en: 「I know that! That's exactly why@ I'll claim you - your very existence, your power!」

0x004712.en: 「Then I'll no longer have to settle@　for being a mere Beta Saber!」

0x004777.en: 「Project Idealants...@　I, the Idealant, will@　seize everything!」

0x004826.en: 「Big words. You planning to conquer@　the world all by yourself?」

0x004879.en: （Duvan... don't tell me he knows about that...?）

0x0048BF.en: 「All units, target the Red Ogre!@　Weaken it and capture it!」

0x00493A.en: 「Hmph, you want the Einst's power too?」

0x0049B4.en: 「Then I'll swallow that resolve of yours whole!@　Along with the Einst!」

0x004A13.en: 「Major Kai,@　if Alfimi falls into their hands here...」

0x004A9D.en: 「She helped us in the final battle with the Einst@　and in the Shura Rebellion. Plus,@　there's Excellen to consider... She should be fine, no?」

0x004B5D.en: 「I've no intention of fighting you.@　And I have a favor to ask.」

0x004BD8.en: 「Someone I'd like you to look after...@　Yes, the one I've pledged my future to.」

0x004C53.en: 「Don't tell me... you mean Captain Axel?」

0x004C8D.en: 「Bingo. We even took our commemorative trip.」

0x004D4B.en: 「Yes.@　For certain reasons, he's asleep for now.」

0x004D89.en: 「But if Axel Almer is with her too...」

0x004DD5.en: 「He did side with us in the Shura Rebellion, though.」

0x004E20.en: 「Major Kai, I'll take full responsibility@　for the Captain. So for now, please...」

0x004EA3.en: 「Your responsibility is mine too.@ ...Captain, I say we take@ Alfimi's offer. What's your call?」

0x004F5A.en: 「There are things I want to ask them.@ Guide the Persoenlichkeit to the Hagane.」

0x005027.en: 「All right, but I can't teleport at the moment.」

0x0050F4.en: 「Tch, worming into their fold won't save you!」

0x005131.en: 「Have all units clear the enemies on our course!」

0x00517B.en: 「Roger!@　Steel 2 to all units!@　Clear the enemy units on our course!」

0x0051E1.en: （...Might be faster to focus our fire@　on the Alles Geist.）

0x005240.en: 「This is Eleve 1! All units near the Hagane,@　clear the enemies on our course and@　defend the Persoenlichkeit Reichkeit!」

0x0052E5.en: 「Units targeting the Alles Geist,@　keep up your attack as you are!」

0x005359.en: 「Ngh, a power-down!?@　It should be activating!」

0x0053B5.en: 「Resonating with the Persoenlichkeit now won't...@ And with a Jetzt core...」

0x00541D.en: 「Tch, if I lose Ares here,@　it's all for nothing...!」

0x005470.en: 「But Einst Alfimi...@　and Ariel! I won't give up!」

0x005500.en: 「Gaia Sabers units, withdrawing from the battle zone!」

0x0055A5.en: 「...Alfimi, back to what we were saying.@　Just where have you been?」

0x005616.en: 「A world unlike this one...@　Yes, let's call it the Endless Frontier.」

0x005684.en: 「You mean you were transferred to another world,@　like me and Lieutenant Kyosuke...!」

0x0056E3.en: 「It's a long story, so I'll spare you the details...@　A lot happened, and I came back to this side@　together with Kouta.」

0x0057BC.en: 「When the gate to this side opened,@ some force seemed to act on it... All I could@ manage was to manifest the Persoenlichkeit and protect Axel.」

0x005870.en: 「Some force...?@　Could it be tied to Ruina's dimensional rift...?」

0x0058D2.en: 「That... I don't know.@　But since I made it back to this side...@　Kouta should have reached this world too.」

0x005983.en: 「B-but what if that boy@　got thrown out into space@　in the flesh...!」

0x0059EF.en: 「Even so,@　he was wearing red armor and riding a flying board,@　so I think he'll be fine.」

0x005A76.en: 「If it were just Kouta, maybe not,@　but if he's got the Roar Armor on, Roar's with him.@　They'll manage somehow, right?」

0x005B3A.en: 「I feared the worst for myself too,@　but I made it to this side somehow.@　...Though I was shocked to end up in La Gias.」

0x005C19.en: 「He should wake soon, so please@　give him my regards.@　...Well then.」

0x005CBC.en: 「A lot happened, and I used too much power.@ There should still be Stone Circle ruins somewhere@ in this universe, so I'll sleep there.」

0x005D79.en: 「And there's something I want to look into, too...@　Farewell.」

0x005DEE.en: 「You... your existence@　is the key that carves open my destiny!」

0x005E4A.en: 「But that core can't correct the distortion.」

0x005E8D.en: 「The Red Ogre's arrival has opened the way,@　Ariel!」

0x005F14.en: 「No, you know it too!@　The one who took in the Einst's power@　and succeeded in controlling it!」

0x005FDE.en: 「You said there was no guarantee, Ariel!@　But with the Red Ogre here, the way's been shown!」

0x006061.en: 「Piling on unstable elements@　doesn't mean you can become@　like Ensign Excellen!」

0x0060EB.en: 「Wrong, I'll go one better than her!」

0x006125.en: 「If you won't surrender,@　this time you're going to die!」

0x00617E.en: 「I've no intention of accepting such a fate...!」

0x0061FB.en: 「So the Fau Kern reacts to the Persoenlichkeit...」

0x006247.en: 「The defective Flickerei's Fau Kern@ also saw its output limit rise. In short,@ its latent power has been unleashed.」

0x0062EF.en: 「Any anomalies detected? Risk of a runaway?」

0x00632F.en: 「None so far.@　Control remains possible, as before.」

0x00638B.en: 「But if the Alles Geist obtains@　the Red Ogre's core...」

0x0063F3.en: 「A high chance it turns into a Jetzt, then.」

0x00643A.en: 「Duvan Org said he was heading for Heaven's Gate.@　If we keep on toward there ourselves,@　we may run into him again.」

0x0064F7.en: 「About that...@　I'm thinking of changing course for the moon.@　To slow the Guests' advance even a little.」

0x006593.en: 「I agree with the Captain.@　Heading moonward makes it easier to respond@　if something happens to the L4 colony cluster.」

0x006626.en: 「Major Kai, a report from Ensign Lamia.@　Axel Almer has regained consciousness.」

0x0066DE.en: 「The Earth vanishing, and all that...@　It sounds like nothing but a bad joke to me.」

0x006740.en: 「This enemy has the power to do just that.@　And right now we've been stripped of rank...@　hunted by both the Federation and the Gaia Sabers.」

0x0067FD.en: 「Just like us, once upon a time.@　On 'the other side' we failed to cut off the head...@　but you lot pulled it off on 'this side.'」

0x0068BA.en: 「...It wasn't by design.@　But I think I understand a little of how Captain Axel@　and Lemon felt before the dimensional transfer.」

0x006990.en: 「The helpless feeling in a hopeless situation...@　All the more so because it wasn't something you chose...」

0x006A10.en: 「Hmph... You've grown more human again@　in the time I haven't seen you.」

0x006A88.en: 「...You and I go way back, don't we, Major Kai.」

0x006AC2.en: 「I'd like to say I'm placing you under arrest...@　but right now we're in much the same boat as you.」

0x006B61.en: 「Do you know anything@　about Kouta Azuma's whereabouts?」

0x006BF1.en: 「...I see. Then you'll be moved to a cell.@　We may have fought together in the Shura Rebellion,@　but I can't just set you free here.」

0x006D7A.en: 「Have we pinned down the Red Ogre's location?」

0x006DEF.en: （Rather than keep up the search,@　might be better to mark the Hagane...@　They were headed for Heaven's Gate too.）

0x006E8E.en: 「Contact on radar.@　High-speed object approaching, 5 o'clock, elevation 35, closing straight in.@　Count: one.」

0x006F0C.en: 「<IFF> confirmed... Omega Saver, Galilnagant.@　Requesting to land aboard our ship.」

0x007013.en: 「What's an Omega Saver?@　And back then, you...」

0x00706C.en: 「Omega answers directly to Lord Alteur, the highest Saver.@　And I am Amara Barton. Remember it.」

0x007375.en: 「Then I'll give the order. Pursue the Hagane!」

0x00743F.en: 「Besides, pursuing the Hagane@　suits your purposes too, doesn't it?」

0x00749E.en: （This one... she talks like she can see right through me...）
